title: Elastic 8.13: GA of Amazon Bedrock in the Elastic AI Assistant for Observability
summary: Elastic 8.13 includes the GA of Amazon Bedrock support within the Elastic AI Assistant for Observability, new vector search configurations, a new integration filter plugin for Logstash, and more.

By


[Brian Bergholm](https://www.elastic.co/blog/author/brian-bergholm)

Today, we are pleased to announce the general availability of Elastic


8.13.


## What’s new?


Three of the most significant components of the 8.13 release include the GA of Amazon Bedrock support within the Elastic AI Assistant for Observability, new vector search configurations, and a new integration filter plugin for Logstash. Additional highlights by solution include the following.


[Elasticsearch](https://www.elastic.co/enterprise-search) helps developers implement modern search and discovery experiences.


-


Read about the expanded toolkit for relevance (including the GA of new vector search configurations, the GA of the synonyms API, and the tech preview of Learning to Rank), enhanced tools for managing connectors (to sync private data for search applications), the tech preview of Elastic’s integration with Cohere and ELSER query optimization, and more in the


[Elasticsearch highlights blog](https://www.elastic.co/blog/whats-new-elastic-search-8-13-0) or in the


[8.13 release notes](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/welcome-to-elastic/current/new.html) .


[Elastic Observability](https://www.elastic.co/observability) transforms metrics, logs, and traces into actionable IT insights to unify observability across the digital ecosystem.


-


Read about the AI Assistant enhancements (including the GA of support for Amazon Bedrock and the tech preview of editing and visualizing ES|QL queries), the GA of SLO enhancements, and more in the


[Elastic Observability highlights blog](https://www.elastic.co/blog/whats-new-elastic-observability-8-13-0) or in the


[Elastic Security](https://www.elastic.co/security) unifies SIEM, endpoint security, and cloud security to detect, investigate, and respond to threats at cloud scale.


-


Read the


[Elastic Security highlights blog](https://www.elastic.co/blog/whats-new-elastic-security-8-13-0) or details in the


All of Elastic’s out-of-the box solutions are built on


[the Elasticsearch Platform](https://www.elastic.co/platform) . All users, regardless of use case, benefit from core enhancements.


- Read about the GA of the resolve cluster API, performance improvements in Kibana, Apache Lucene 9.10, a new Logstash integration filter, the GA of Elastic Agent support for Kafka, and more in the


[Elasticsearch Platform highlights blog](https://www.elastic.co/blog/whats-new-elasticsearch-platform-8-13-0) or in the

## Start today


Ready to get started? Elastic 8.13 is


[now available on Elastic Cloud](https://cloud.elastic.co/registration?elektra=whats-new-elastic-8-7-0-blog) — the hosted Elasticsearch service that includes all of the new features in this latest release.
